source: declared — Growth Factor AI is our own brand, so there is no prior site to mine. Direction set by the client (Ben) in brief: burnt orange accent borrowed from jonmayo.com, black replaced with super dark blue.
title: Growth Factor AI
note: jonmayo.com could not be fetched from this environment (egress blocked), so the ember hue is a considered pick against the brief 'mellow burnt orange, not too bright, not overstimulating' rather than a sampled value. Confirm against the real site before this kernel is locked.

type.family: Archivo (400/500/600/700) — one grotesque carries the whole page
type.utility: JetBrains Mono (400/500) — micro-labels, figures, fine print
type.stance: 5 body-led — no display face; hierarchy from weight, case, rule and space
type.hosting: self-hosted variable woff2, latin subset, in site/assets/fonts/

geometry.radius: 0px everywhere, no exceptions — including buttons and inputs

motifs: Ember hairline spine — a 1px vertical rule the content sits offset to the right of; an ember tick marks where each section's rail meets it. Repeated as the nav underline and the .note left border.
Mono micro-label — uppercase JetBrains Mono with a 9px hollow ember square before it. Section eyebrows. Deliberately NOT numbered (client dislikes the 01/02/03 device on jonmayo.com).
Node/edge diagram — thin ember lines joining small squares; hollow square = input, filled square = the agent acting. Draws itself in on scroll. Hero background and the Super Agent explainer.
Terminal caret — a blinking ember block after a rotating line. Used exactly once, in the hero.
Ladder tick — an 11px square per step, alternating filled/hollow, carrying sequence without printing numerals.
